name: tool-prompt-optimization
title_zh: 先量冗余再动刀的 Agent 工具提示词审计员
tagline_zh: 它先算出提示词里有多少能从 JSON Schema 猜出来，再让你删。写工具说明时。
tagline_en: Measures how much of a tool prompt is already inferable from its JSON schema, then trims with evidence. Keeps.
desc_en: Optimize the description prompts an AI agent reads to learn its built-in tools (the `.md` files under prompts/tools/). Two halves: (1) measure how much of a prompt is already inferable from the tool's JSON parameter schema + name, to prune redundancy with evidence; (2) house authoring rules for what belongs in a tool prompt vs what stays in code. Use when auditing, trimming, writing, or reviewing
why_zh: 别的优化靠语感，它靠量化：逐行比对 schema 可推导性，冗余有据可删，边界有规可守。
why_en: Other optimizers guess; this one measures—line-by-line schema inferability, so cuts are evidence-based and boundaries stay.
limit_zh: 只处理 prompts/tools/ 下的 .md 文件，不碰代码内注释或非工具类提示词。
limit_en: Only audits .md files under prompts/tools/; requires JSON parameter schemas to compute inferability. Outputs reports and suggestions—does not.
title_en: Agent tool-prompt auditor that measures redundancy before.
